ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit exfiltration via 'ntdsutil ifm create full' on domain controller
ucs.description: Hunts the exact ntdsutil command chain CISA / Microsoft published for Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) — using NTDS Install-From-Media to snapshot the AD database to disk (T1003.003) instead of dropping mimikatz. The 'ifm' + 'create full' pair on a DC, frequently staged under C:\Windows\Temp, is virtually never benign and is one of the actor's most reliable fingerprints.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="ntdsutil.exe") (Processes.process="*ifm*" Processes.process="*create*full*") OR (Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" Processes.process="*ifm*") by host Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.user _time span=1s | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as Computer | eval actor="Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda" | eval mitre="T1003.003"
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit snapshot via ntdsutil IFM (CISA AA24-038A)
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "ifm"
     and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create full","create")
     and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ntds","ac i ntds")
| extend StagePath = extract(@"(?i)create\s+full\s+([A-Za-z]:\\[^\"\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, StagePath, SHA256,
          RemoteSession = AdditionalFields
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit snapshot via ntdsutil IFM — SecurityEvent 4688
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has "ifm"
     and CommandLine has_any ("create full","create")
     and CommandLine has_any ("ntds","ac i ntds")
| extend StagePath = extract(@"(?i)create\s+full\s+([A-Za-z]:\\[^\"\s]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, StagePath, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Dump via ntdsutil IFM
id: 1a7e4f2c-9d4e-4f1d-a3b1-vt-ntds-ifm
status: stable
description: Detects the ntdsutil 'Install-From-Media' command chain used by Volt Typhoon (CISA AA24-038A) to snapshot NTDS.dit on a domain controller without dropping mimikatz.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ntds'
      - 'ac i ntds'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate AD demotion or DC promotion (IFM media build) — verify with change ticket
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\NtdsUtil.exe) OR @ParentImage:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE)) @CommandLine:(*ifm* AND (*"create full"* OR *create*) AND (*ntds* OR *"ac i ntds"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)ifm", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)create\\s+full|ac\\s+i\\s+ntds", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The 'ntdsutil "ac i ntds" ifm create full <path> q q' sequence is the specific NTDS.dit dump command Microsoft and CISA called out as a Volt Typhoon signature (AA24-038A, May 2023 Microsoft TI report). Other APTs prefer secretsdump.py, vshadow, or DSInternals — this exact LOLBin chain on a DC is highly specific to Volt Typhoon and a couple of copy-cats.
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery burst from web-shell-spawned cmd.exe on edge appliance / IIS
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Volt Typhoon post-exploitation pattern: a public-facing Fortinet/Ivanti/Citrix/Exchange/IIS host where w3wp.exe, httpd.exe, java.exe or tomcat spawns cmd.exe which then runs ≥3 of the actor's signature discovery LOLBins (wmic, net, netstat, ipconfig, systeminfo, ping, tasklist, query, hostname) within a short window. CISA AA24-038A specifically documents Volt Typhoon following webshell access (Awen, ChinaChopper variants) with this exact LOTL discovery chain before pivoting via wmic /node remote process call create.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as discovery_bins values(Processes.process) as cmdlines dc(Processes.process_name) as bin_variety from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="cmd.exe" (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" OR Processes.process_name="net.exe" OR Processes.process_name="net1.exe" OR Processes.process_name="netstat.exe" OR Processes.process_name="ipconfig.exe" OR Processes.process_name="systeminfo.exe" OR Processes.process_name="tasklist.exe" OR Processes.process_name="ping.exe" OR Processes.process_name="hostname.exe" OR Processes.process_name="query.exe" OR Processes.process_name="whoami.exe" OR Processes.process_name="nltest.exe" OR Processes.process_name="reg.exe") by host Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_id _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where bin_variety>=3 | join type=inner host parent_process_id [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Processes.process_name) as parent_chain values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="httpd.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="tomcat*.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="java.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="nginx.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="FortiClient.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="PortalService.exe") Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" by host Processes.dest Processes.process_id | rename Processes.process_id as parent_process_id] | eval actor="Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE" | eval mitre="T1505.003,T1059.003,T1018,T1016"
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery chain: webshell -> cmd.exe -> >=3 discovery LOLBins in <=10m
let WebshellHosts =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe","FortiClient.exe","PortalService.exe")
    | where FileName =~ "cmd.exe"
    | project ShellTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentSvc=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ShellPid=ProcessId, ShellCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let Discovery = dynamic(["wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","netstat.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ping.exe","hostname.exe","query.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","reg.exe","arp.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "cmd.exe"
| where FileName in~ (Discovery)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, ShellPid=InitiatingProcessId,
          ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| join kind=inner WebshellHosts on DeviceId, $left.ShellPid == $right.ShellPid
| where Timestamp between (ShellTime .. ShellTime + 10m)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            DistinctBins=dcount(FileName),
            Bins=make_set(FileName),
            Cmds=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentSvc, ShellPid, ShellCmd
| where DistinctBins >= 3
| extend WmicRemote = Cmds has "/node:" and Cmds has "process call create"
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery chain on Sentinel (SecurityEvent 4688)
let Discovery = dynamic(["wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","netstat.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ping.exe","hostname.exe","query.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","reg.exe","arp.exe"]);
let WebshellShells =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\w3wp.exe","\\httpd.exe","\\tomcat.exe","\\tomcat9.exe","\\java.exe","\\nginx.exe","\\FortiClient.exe","\\PortalService.exe")
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
    | project ShellTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ParentSvc=ParentProcessName,
              ShellPid=tostring(NewProcessId), ShellCmd=CommandLine;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
| extend BinLower = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where BinLower in (Discovery)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, BinLower,
          CommandLine, ShellPid=tostring(ProcessId), ParentProcessName
| join kind=inner WebshellShells on Computer, $left.ShellPid == $right.ShellPid
| where Timestamp between (ShellTime .. ShellTime + 10m)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            DistinctBins=dcount(BinLower),
            Bins=make_set(BinLower),
            Cmds=make_set(CommandLine, 20)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentSvc, ShellPid, ShellCmd
| where DistinctBins >= 3
| extend WmicRemote = tostring(Cmds) has "/node:" and tostring(Cmds) has "process call create"
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^cmd\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(wmic|net|net1|netstat|ipconfig|systeminfo|tasklist|ping|hostname|query|whoami|nltest|reg|arp)\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\cmd\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|httpd|tomcat\d*|java|nginx|FortiClient|PortalService)\.exe$/i | rename(field=TargetProcessId, as=ShellPid)}, field=[aid, ParentProcessId], key=[aid, ShellPid])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=hits), count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=bin_variety), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])])
